name: Cheesy Sweet Potato-Kidney Bean Burrito with Avocado Dip (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices (reducing chili powder if needed for sensitive palates). Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp chili powder
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the onion is cooking, drain and rinse beans.
When the onion is done, add beans and salt to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until beans are warmed through, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Set aside.
When the sweet potatoes are almost done, return beans to medium heat, add cheddar, and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until cheese is melted, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Place 1 cup of the cheesy beans on a plate for the kids. Lay tortillas on a flat surface, then divide remaining beans between them. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Add 1 cup roasted sweet potatoes to the plate with the cheesy beans and set aside. Divide remaining sweet potatoes between tortillas, arranging the filling in the center of each. Drizzle filling with hot sauce and sprinkle with cilantro. Fold in the sides of tortillas and roll tightly to close the burritos.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Lay burritos, seam-side down, in the skillet and cook, rotating every 1-2 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Remove from heat.

Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Slice half of the avocado lengthwise into ½-inch thick wedges. Place remaining avocado in a small bowl, add sour cream and spices, then mash with a fork or potato masher to combine the avocado dip.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup sour cream
¼ tsp cumin, ground
⅛ tsp garlic powder
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved cheesy beans, roasted sweet potatoes, avocado wedges, and additional sour cream between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Cut burritos in half and divide between plates. Serve with avocado dip and enjoy!
